

==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythical}} unit. He is only obtainable from [[Summon|summon]]. When you obtain Griffin you will automatically be rewarded the Periapt of the King.

{{EvolutionTable}}
{{Takedowns|7,500}}  

Additionally, he requires at least 100% Ascension in the Periapt of the King to evolve. 

== About Ascension ==
When one uses the Periapt of the King in the Items section of their inventory, they will be teleported to a domain. By talking to the Griffin (Fallen) NPC, the player will be immediately given the choice between [Ascend] and [Sacrifice]. If [Sacrifice] is selected, the player will be offered a choice between sacrificing Periapts of Sacrifice, which raises Ascension by 0.5% each, or sacrificing Mythic units, giving 4.2% for unevolved units and 8.4% for evolved units. Any Mythics can be sacrificed, including Griffin and his evolved variant. If [Ascend] is selected the inventory will pop up, prompting the player to pick the Griffin they want to evolve, consuming 100% of the Ascension stored. 

Do note that before sacrificing an eligible unit, one will be given a warning similar to that seen when sacrificing eligible units to the [[Supreme Being|Sovereign's Staff]].
